entry.title: Toyota Brings the Buzz with Honeycomb and Hot Honey Colors for 2027 TRD Pro Models
entry.content: PLANO, Texas (July 28, 2026) — Toyota is expanding its TRD Pro color palette for 2027 with the introduction of a new Honeycomb exterior color for Tundra, Sequoia and Tacoma, along with a slightly different shade, Hot Honey, for the 4Runner. The post Toyota Brings the Buzz with Honeycomb and Hot Honey Colors for 2027 TRD Pro Models appeared first on Toyota USA Newsroom .

entry.title: Toyota Mobility Foundation Names Winning Innovators across Varanasi, Venice, and Detroit in Global Sustainable Cities Challenge
entry.content: Toyota Mobility Foundation (TMF) announces the full list of winners of its global Sustainable Cities Challenge (SCC), the organization's largest initiative to date. The news follows last week's conclusion of the Challenge's final of three sections, held in Varanasi, India, after the winners in the other two host citiesâDetroit, Michigan, and Venice, Italyâwere named earlier this year, as they shared their winning innovators and mobility solutions.

entry.title: Hydrogen Engine Year Six--A World First & New Partners at the Fuji 24 Hours
entry.content: The 2026 Super Taikyu Fuji 24-hour race saw Toyota competing with a hydrogen engine for the sixth straight year. This time, the team took on the world's first challenge using superconducting technology.
